subject.title: ci: add unsigned iOS build workflow

question: Should OpenClaw core own an unsigned iOS xcarchive workflow once the input and token hardening is fixed?
rationale: The remaining mechanical blockers are clear, but adding a new artifact-producing macOS workflow changes maintainer-owned CI and artifact distribution surface.

options.title: Harden And Keep The Workflow
options.body: Validate inputs, reduce token exposure, align setup with sibling workflows, rerun proof, and then let maintainers decide final acceptance of the lane.

options.title: Keep It External
options.body: Leave the fork workflow as an external experiment if OpenClaw core should not own unsigned iOS artifacts.

options.title: Fold Into Existing iOS CI
options.body: Replace the standalone workflow with a maintainer-owned path inside existing iOS CI if a separate manual lane is not desired.

recommendation.title: Harden And Keep The Workflow
recommendation.body: Validate inputs, reduce token exposure, align setup with sibling workflows, rerun proof, and then let maintainers decide final acceptance of the lane.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal is recent workflow hardening and sibling iOS CI ownership.
